title: KupkaProd Cinema Pipeline: Local Agentic AI Movie Studio
summary: An autonomous local pipeline that converts text prompts or screenplays into produced cinematic videos using agentic LLMs. It orchestrates script analysis, storyboarding, and video generation within a unified ComfyUI-based environment.
research_notes: Integrates Gemma-based models for scriptwriting and LTX 2.3/LTX-AV for video generation; part of the AgentSkills ecosystem.

evolution.summary: Evolved from individual scripts into a full-featured agentic movie studio using Ollama for direction and LTX-Video for synthesis. Now supports automated scene planning, multi-take generation, and built-in editing tools.
